name: Roxo-paper NE-MCTS (purchase, combat move, non-combat move)
description: Non-exploring MCTS as Roxo's thesis applies it to TripleA, on the oep_paper framework: one tree ply per territory (or unit rule) decision with Roxo's pruned options, best-mean selection with every child visited once, deterministic 10-round Weak AI playouts rated with Roxo's reward, deterministic Fast AI battles, transposition table.
